title: Wall Street's $30,000 Secret Is Now a Free GitHub Repo (Kronos AI)
description:
The $30,000 Wall Street terminal just got replaced by a free GitHub repo.

It's called Kronos — an open-source foundation model built by Tsinghua University for financial markets. Instead of reading candlestick charts the way traders do, Kronos tokenizes OHLCV data (open, high, low, close, volume) the same way large language models tokenize words. It's not reading language — it's reading the language of markets.

Trained across 45+ exchanges spanning stocks, crypto, and forex, Kronos represents the kind of proprietary modeling hedge funds have spent billions building behind closed doors — now available to anyone for free.


#Kronos #AITrading  #Tsinghua #StockMarket #CryptoAI
